column1: # comment: "GMEOW sign-system \u2192 IANA Language Subtag Registry (BCP-47) alignments. A BCP-47 primary language subtag (e.g. \"en\") is registered by IANA (drawn from ISO 639); the registry resource is a code-scoped identifier, a related resource rather than identity (skos:relatedMatch). By reference, curl-validated."

column7: The IANA Language Subtag Registry defines en as the BCP-47 primary language subtag for English (there is no per-subtag resolvable IRI; the registry is the authoritative resource). A code-scoped identifier, a related resource rather than identity, so skos:relatedMatch.
